body.name: reduced primal--dual saddle program
body.construction: For every nonsingular response basis \(\beta\), set \(w_{x,\beta}=\widetilde B_\beta^{-1}\widetilde p_x\), retain \(\beta\in\mathcal B_x(p_x)\) when \(w_{x,\beta}\geq0\), and solve \(\min_{q,t}t\) subject to \(q\in\Delta_K\) and \(G_{(b,\beta),\cdot}(p_x)q\leq t\) for every \(b\in\mathcal A\) and \(\beta\in\mathcal B_x(p_x)\). Duplicate projected vertices may be retained because they do not change the feasible epigraph.
